scope: The permanent Centre Block, including its integral Peace Tower, plus the East and West blocks of Parliament Hill. Library of Parliament is a separately queued building.

originalReview.notes: The exact 2012 side exterior resolves the current Peace Tower’s sandstone clock stage, dark-patina copper spire and neighbouring Centre Block roof shapes.
Exact 2010 Peace Tower clock exterior resolves the Gothic stone frame, circular dial and radial dark divisions.
Exact 2024 East Block exterior from near the eastern edge of the parliamentary lawn. It shows the stone facade, tall pointed entry, broken roof line, dark-patina green roof, buttresses and dormers.
Exact 2024 West Block exterior, resolving its dark roof, slender spires, Mackenzie Tower, Gothic window rows and deep secondary porch.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s Peace Tower article provides the exact CC0 exterior used for the connected main building. The three other verified originals refine the Peace Tower clock and the East/West Block buildings, which are distinct structures on the grounds. The older Centre Block visible in nineteenth-century references was destroyed in 1916. The official U.S. military portrait is indoors and the 1913 river photograph does not show the buildings. Photographs with attribution conditions, unclear provenance or temporary works are excluded.
